main_effect:
＜Collision＞ (During this Digimon's attack, all of your opponent's Digimon gain ＜Blocker＞, and must block if possible.)
＜Fragment (3)＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted, by trashing any 3 of its digivolution cards, it isn't deleted.)
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Until your opponent's turn ends, give 1 of their Digimon "[Start of Your Main Phase] This Digimon attacks."
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When Digimon attack, by trashing any 2 of this Digimon's digivolution cards, this Digimon gains ＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.) and +3000 DP until your turn ends.
